notes: ['All reachable pages of the public general credit/debit search plus fixed credit/debit/coalition/government/premium/character catalogs were enumerated and deduplicated by official entry ID: 287 distinct entries. Five additional premium entries explicitly displayed on the official main/card-finder pages were added using linked detail API responses, for 292 total entries.', 'Card types 0/1 in the official API were mapped to personal credit/debit. 189 credit and 98 debit in the initial union; additional premium entries are credit. Group, employer, government, fuel-subsidy, partner, and design variants remain separate with application/eligibility notes. Corporate business-site cards were not scraped.', 'The fixed catalog reports totalSize values that can exceed the number returned on individual pages; all reachable pages were requested, but completeness across all restricted, branch-only, and partner distribution channels cannot be established. Several premium products appear on the main/card finder and are omitted from the fixed premium catalog.', '54 linked detail pages were parsed for additional benefits, minimum spending conditions, caps, exclusions, and eligibility. Other entries use the issuer catalog fee, image, and headline benefits, with unknown detail conditions left null/empty.', 'Application status is confirmed only when the official catalog exposes a enabled full/simple/phone application flag or linked official offered detail. This is evidence of an application route, not universal applicant eligibility.', 'Document links are only included when actual PDF URLs were observed; some are international-brand service guides rather than complete product-specific terms.']

['The union of all 10 displayed credit benefit categories and all 8 displayed debit benefit categories yielded 134 product entries. Main-page-only entries, seven HERITAGE premium products, three BeV products, and two platinum products were then added. The personal subsidy card 보탬e전용카드 is included because official detail text explicitly describes eligible individual subsidy recipients. 148 total unique cooperation codes.', 'All 148 linked product detail pages were fetched. Official headline benefits were extracted for every product, 145 observed product-document links were captured, and available fees were extracted where unambiguous. Some spend thresholds and caps remain null when detail tables cannot be associated safely with a particular benefit.', 'The available benefit lists lack an authoritative complete total, and student-ID, branch-only, partner-specific, or restricted distributions may exist outside them. Completeness is therefore not asserted. Corporate cards from the separate business site were not included; personal business-owner/fuel-subsidy/group cards from the personal catalog are retained.', 'General-card and available mobile-only fees were observed and the minimum offered personal fee is used. Product detail is preferred over category listing when they disagree. LFmall credit card shows a catalog/detail annual-fee discrepancy (15,000원 versus 25,000원), explicitly recorded on the entry.', 'Special eligibility and application restrictions observed in product pages are retained in eligibility. Application controls are availability evidence, subject to issuer conditions.']

공식 키워드검색의 빈 검색 조건 결과 168개 항목을 전부 열거했습니다. 기프트카드 및 e나라도움 보조금 결제 전용 카드 6개를 제외한 개인 신용·체크 162개입니다. SOHO 등 개인사업자용, 공무원·지역·복지 자격 한정 상품을 포함합니다. 온라인 신청 버튼 유무를 confirmed/catalog로 구분했으며 catalog는 신규발급 확정이 아닙니다. 공식 공개 목록의 완전성만 의미하며 비공개 영업점 상품까지 전체 시장이라고 보장하지 않습니다.

공식 CreditSearch.do 및 CheckSearch.do의 mbNo=050, retKey=json 결과를 PAGE_COUNT 끝까지 열거: 신용22, 체크2. 공식 상품공시 ind0836의 발급 중단일과 상세페이지 브랜드 중단 안내도 확인했습니다. 법인 전용 상품은 제외합니다. 5종 신세계 제휴카드의 발급중단 VISA 브랜드는 제외했습니다. 공개 API 발급사 범위의 전체목록이며 BC회원사 다른 은행 상품은 해당 발급사로 분리했습니다.

IBK 자체 공개 목록은 135개(기업 및 판매중지 포함)를 보여주지만 원문 요청이 반복502로 실패했습니다. 대신 BC카드 공식 IBK회원사 공개 API mbNo=003를 모든 페이지까지 열거: 신용32, 체크26. BC공식 상세페이지의 IBK 발급대상·혜택·신청 링크를 확인했습니다. 완전성은 현재 BC 공식 IBK회원사 공개목록에 한하며 IBK의 전체 오프라인·비BC 제품까지 확인한 것은 아닙니다. 대한항공 I-Mileage 상세 안내에 남은 발급중단 아시아나 변형은 제외했습니다.
